quests.title: Battery graphite
quests.text: The graphite line floats and rounds graphite schist; the graphite furnace purifies it to 99.95 % carbon at about 2,800 C, a 1.4 MW load on a distribution feed, purged with nitrogen from a nitrogen generator.

quests.title: Cathode powder
quests.text: The LFP kiln: iron ingots, phosphoric acid from the fertilizer plant and lithium carbonate, calcined at 700 C under nitrogen. The lithium plant makes the hydroxide; the carbonator turns it to carbonate with liquid CO2 from the CO2 liquefier on the lime kiln's gas.

quests.title: A battery module
quests.text: The cell line coats, stacks, fills and forms 52 cells into a 52.2 kWh module every 10 minutes. It takes aluminium ingots for the foil; its electrolyte takes ethylene and anhydrous HF from an HF kiln and column.

quests.title: A battery cabinet
quests.text: Five modules in a 125 kW cabinet on a 480 V feeder: peak shaving beside a genset, or frequency response on a small island.

quests.title: A battery on the grid
quests.text: A PCS, two containers of 96 modules and an MV skid on a distribution feeder: 2.5 MW for four hours. The PCS is built with aluminium ingots.

quests.title: A grid from a battery
quests.text: Set a block (or a cabinet) to GRID FORMING on a dead bus: it closes with a soft start and holds the island while a genset synchronises to it.

tasks.text: Black-start a dead bus from a battery
